description: Ministry of Labour - The Industrial Dispute between Richard Pieris Exports Plc. Vs. The Ceylon Mercantile Industrial and General Workers' Union (E only)
reasoning: This gazette content concerns the repudiation of an arbitrator's award under the Industrial Disputes Act. It is a legal notice published in accordance with specific sections of the Act (Section 20(1) and 20(2)(b)), declaring that a previous award will cease to have effect. This falls squarely under the "Legal/Regulatory" category (Type 5) as it deals with statutory instruments, legal procedures, and the implementation of an existing Act.
